# Function Objective: Compute the average score of a class
# Input parameters : i_total_score (integer) sum of all scores, i_student_total_num (integer) number of students
# Function description: Divide the total score by the number of students; a class without students gives zero
# Return Value : float average score
# Created By : Programmer A
# Create Date: 2026-09-28
# Revised By:
# Revised Date:
def f_Get_Average(i_total_score, i_student_total_num):
    fAverage = 0.0
    bln_Is_Done = False
    try:
        # divide the total score by the number of students
        fAverage = i_total_score / i_student_total_num
    except ZeroDivisionError:
        # no student registered, the average stays zero
        fAverage = 0.0
    finally:
        # mark the calculation as finished
        bln_Is_Done = True
    return fAverage
